t: The Sovereign Craftsman's Way: Building AI Tools for Ethical Knowledge Mastery
s: This article advocates for computational sovereignty by ethically leveraging large context windows in frontier AI models. It proposes building 'gooeyless' tools that empower individuals, challenging dystopian AI futures and promoting a creative, non-predatory path towards knowledge management and tool development.
sub: Flooding large AI context windows ('desert kite') to tailor intelligence beyond 'wisdom of the crowd'.
Critique of 'scrap-and-rebuild' AI coding versus long-term craftsmanship.
Transitioning from GUI to 'gooeyless' automation via TUIs and command-line piping.
H.G. Wells' 'Eloi and Morlocks' prophecy as an AI societal schism allegory.
Echoes of market consolidation in cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) mirroring old media networks.
